wizards.reads: Sensei Top reads the log files Magic: The Gathering Arena and Magic Online write on this machine. It changes neither client and reads nothing from their memory.
wizards.images: Card images are shown whole. Where card art appears on its own, the button in its corner shows the whole card, which carries the artist's name and the copyright line.

dataSources.heading: Data sources
dataSources.opening: Sensei Top bundles none of this data. Each installed copy downloads what it needs to the machine it runs on.
dataSources.closing: Sensei Top is not produced by, endorsed by or affiliated with Scryfall, TopDeck.gg, Daybreak Games and mtgo.com, melee.gg, Anthropic, or the maintainers of MTGOFormatData and MTG_decklistcache. Their names appear here to credit their work.

scryfall.taken: Card names, rules text, legality, card images and card art.

mtgoFormatData.taken: The archetype definitions that name an opponent's deck. Jiliac's fork is the fallback when the first repository cannot be reached.
mtgoFormatData.terms: Neither repository carries a licence file.

decklistCache.taken: MTGO and Melee tournament results for the Field page.
decklistCache.terms: GPL-3.0. Downloaded by each copy, never bundled or redistributed by this project.

topdeck.taken: Tournament results, through their API and your own free key.
topdeck.terms: Used under TopDeck.gg's API terms, read 2026-10-05: free to use, a visible credit and link back required, inside its rate limits.

mtgo.taken: The public result pages of events in the formats you follow: decklists, standings and brackets. Player handles are dropped when the page is read and never stored.
mtgo.terms: Read against Daybreak's Terms of Service and the MTGO EULA on 2026-10-05: fetched slowly by your own copy, for your own use, and shown with a link to each event's page on mtgo.com.

anthropic.taken: The Claude API, only when you configure a key and press a generate button.
anthropic.terms: Your own account and key, under Anthropic's terms.

fonts.heading: Fonts and symbols
fonts.opening: These ship inside the dashboard. Each is listed with its copyright notice and the licence is linked below; its full text is with the dashboard libraries' notices, under "Software it is built on".

software.heading: Software it is built on
software.opening: Sensei Top is built from free software. Each work below is listed with its licence; the full texts travel with every copy, where the entry says.

electron.name: Electron and Chromium
electron.usedFor: The desktop app's window. Not involved when the dashboard is opened in your own browser from the command line.
electron.notice: Electron under the MIT licence, its text in LICENSE.electron.txt; Chromium's notices in LICENSES.chromium.html. Both files are in the folder the desktop app is installed in.

desktop.name: Desktop app libraries
desktop.usedFor: electron-updater and the packages it depends on, which check for the desktop app's updates and install them.
desktop.notice: Mostly MIT and ISC licences; sax under the Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 and argparse under the Python License 2.0. The desktop app installs every text in resources/licenses/desktop-third-party-notices.txt.

python.name: Python
python.usedFor: The server that reads the logs and serves this dashboard.
python.notice: PSF License, with the libraries compiled into it (OpenSSL, SQLite, libffi, zlib, bzip2, xz, expat, mpdecimal, libedit) under their own licences. The desktop app installs the texts under resources/server/licenses; a command-line install carries them in its Python environment.

pythonLibraries.name: Python libraries
pythonLibraries.usedFor: FastAPI, Starlette, Uvicorn, pydantic, orjson, keyring, cryptography, the Anthropic SDK and the packages they depend on.
pythonLibraries.notice: MIT, BSD, Apache 2.0 and PSF licences; orjson in part under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, with its source at github.com/ijl/orjson. The desktop app installs each text in resources/server/licenses/python, listed in INDEX.txt there; a command-line install carries them in its Python environment.

dashboard.name: Dashboard libraries
dashboard.usedFor: React, TanStack Query, React Router, Recharts, Lucide and the packages they depend on, built into this page.
dashboard.notice: Mostly MIT and ISC licences. Every copyright notice and licence text is below.

pyinstaller.name: PyInstaller
pyinstaller.usedFor: Packages the server for the desktop app.
pyinstaller.notice: GPL 2 or later with the Bootloader Exception; its run-time hooks under Apache 2.0. Text in resources/server/licenses.

notices.failed: The notices could not be loaded. They are in third-party-notices.txt, in the folder the dashboard is served from.
